notes.title: Hello Everyone!
notes.notes:
Hello!
It's been a minute since Walkbot was released. It's actually been more than 2 years but who's counting! I think an update on what we're up to is long overdue.

Let’s kick it off with who I am - hi, * waves awkwardly * I’m Natalie, usually known as gnatamania online and I joined Pointless Games as co-founder earlier this year to start driving the projects we have wanted to do for a while. Walkbot was the first game Pointless Games released and we’ve always wanted to do more. We are now a full team working on two games at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649639/203f1a929bbc33d2a3f78e99f853dc490d6d0635.jpg[/img]

Our PC game, Stones of Power is currently in early closed alpha here on Steam. It’s a rogue-lite deckbuilder that incorporates grid mechanics and people seem to be enjoying it. We push an update every week so if you’re interested in playtesting you can request access on the Steam Store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649639/d00a1fdf5dc4a05f8f748ad46876269cf3bc006d.gif[/img]

Our main focus is an unannounced VR game. If you didn’t know, Walkbot was created specifically to give us the skill set to make VR games in Unreal Engine and we are now putting all that knowledge to good use! We can’t say much about it yet but we are very excited and can’t wait to share more. I’ll just tease this early prototype item and let you guess what it could be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649639/6b97b44fee3f9a32704314f1097dfc4ab03052cf.gif[/img]

And that’s all from us for now! If you are interested in knowing more about what we are up to or want to give us feedback, go join our Community Discord
